semantics: Class-based tool policy for the Cline CLI (Plan 032 Phase 8, ADR 0028): the canonical tool names of the CLI build, the capability class each serves, and the conditions under which it exists. A configured agent's tools: list takes these canonical names and is enforced by the host, so a role's grant here is the list its file carries (legacy names are aliased onto the canonical ones by the CLI). Configured agents themselves appear to the lead as dynamic subagent_<name> tools and are not catalogued here. Names come from the CLI's own tables (observations, 2026-10-02), not from the docs' tools page, which uses a different vocabulary; the IDE extensions' names are unverified.
